scope: Preserve the delivered module APIs, feature-local UI/data access, extracted SQLite helpers/migrations and automated import-boundary checks.
When a workflow requires changes, extract its remaining HTTP/MCP routing, bootstrap wiring or facade responsibility behind explicit APIs. Avoid a repository-wide rename or line-count target.
